name: fillfaster
description: Browser extension to snapshot and fill web forms (TypeScript, React, MV3, AI fill)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && vite build -c vite.background.config.ts
scripts.watch: vite build --watch & vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch & vite build -c vite.background.config.ts --watch
